_readme: The ONE place to edit links and placeholders. After editing, run: python3 build.py   (needs only Python 3, no installs).
_site_url_note: Optional. Absolute URL where this site is hosted, e.g. https://open-medical-affairs.github.io/ai-in-action/ . Leave blank and links stay relative; the page fills its own URL in at runtime.

grokbot._note: Fill signup_url and credits_code when you have them. Blank values show the 'Shared at the conference' placeholder.

datasets_source._note: Datasets live in github.com/Open-Medical-Affairs/Data-Sources. Content paths that start with path_prefix_from are linked to this repository (prefix replaced by path_prefix_to); every other dataset path (starter bundles, change cards, templates, examples) links to the skills repo above.
